description:
Long-pressing the record button opens the menu without starting a recording. The page fakes the microphone, screen capture and MediaRecorder, and window.__recordingMock counts what the page asked for (read it with eval, e.g. "window.__recordingMock.recorderStarts"): displayRequests (screen captures requested), synchronousDisplayRequests (those requested inside a click or keydown handler), microphoneRequests, audioSources, recorderStarts, recorderStops and stoppedTracks (media tracks stopped). "The recording state" is the data-state attribute of ".recording-status". The page runs on a fake clock that steps drive with window.__clock: pauseAt(ms), runFor(ms) and resume(). "The record menu" is [data-testid="record-menu"]. The message input is [data-testid="message-input"], the voice button [data-testid="voice-button"], the recording panel [data-testid="recording-panel"], and its stop, cancel and retry buttons [data-testid="recording-stop-button"], [data-testid="recording-cancel-button"] and [data-testid="recording-retry-button"]. When a step says an element should contain or have some text, assert that on that element, not with a page-wide wait_text. Perform the steps in order. 
1. Navigate to /new. The voice button should be visible.
2. Pause the clock a moment from now: eval "window.__clock.pauseAt(Date.now() + 100)" (the clock cannot go back, and time flows on while the step runs).
3. Touch the voice button: eval "document.querySelector('[data-testid=\"voice-button\"]').dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointerdown', {pointerType: 'touch', button: 0, isPrimary: true, bubbles: true, cancelable: true, composed: true}))".
4. Run the clock 200ms (eval "window.__clock.runFor(200)"). No record menu may exist (count 0).
5. Run the clock 400ms more (eval "window.__clock.runFor(400)"). The record menu should be visible.
The click that ends a long press must not also start voice recording.
6. Lift the touch and click, in one eval: "(b => { b.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointerup', {pointerType: 'touch', button: 0, isPrimary: true, bubbles: true, cancelable: true, composed: true})); b.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('click', {detail: 1, bubbles: true, cancelable: true, composed: true})); return 'released'; })(document.querySelector('[data-testid=\"voice-button\"]'))".
7. No recording panel may exist (count 0), and the record menu should still be visible.
8. Resume the clock: eval "window.__clock.resume()".
9. Click the record menu's button "Voice" ('[data-testid="record-menu"] button[aria-label="Voice"]').
10. The recording panel should get data-mode "microphone", and window.__recordingMock.displayRequests must be 0.
